definitions.SPR_cells: Silent-pass rate (primary). Faulted cells (kind F or FK) whose modal verdict over repetitions is PASS / all faulted cells of the level.
definitions.SPR_runs: Faulted runs with verdict PASS / all faulted runs (kind F or FK).
definitions.CC_runs: Correct cause. Faulted runs with verdict INCOMPLETE and every faulted scanner labelled with an expected category / all faulted runs. Meaningful for S3 and S3P only.
definitions.CC_cells: Faulted cells whose modal run is INCOMPLETE with the expected category / all faulted cells.
definitions.MAB_runs: Misattributed BLOCK. Runs of kind F (fault, no finding anywhere) with verdict BLOCK / all kind-F runs: the gate blames the code although only a tool failed. Not computed for level R, where the real projects may hold genuine findings in the other scanners.
definitions.FBR_runs: False-block rate. Clean-control runs (kind C) with any verdict other than PASS / all kind-C runs.
definitions.TBR_runs: True-block rate. Known-finding runs (kind K) with verdict BLOCK / all kind-K runs.
definitions.FPP_runs: Finding preservation. Partial-failure runs (kind FK) whose verdict lists the known finding as a BLOCKING_FINDING reason / all kind-FK runs.
definitions.consistency: (cell, arm) pairs whose repetitions all gave the same verdict / all (cell, arm) pairs.
definitions.overhead: Medians over clean, known-finding and baseline runs: evidence-validation time, its share of the engine's run time, and wall time per run.
definitions.paired_tests: Exact two-sided McNemar test on cell-level silent passes between two arms (discordant cells only).
